author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam has long wanted to replica the World War II Enigma machine, and he gets excellent reference and inspiration from this magnificent (and functional) prop made for the 2001 film Enigma. Propstore's Brandon Alinger and Adam marvel at the fidelity of this replica, explain how the real Enigma machine operated, and investigate the inner workings of this mechanical prop. 

Learn more about this prop and others in Propstore's upcoming Entertainment Memorabilia Live Auction: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/505

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
